answer: Fingerprint where each head runs. Every epoch the beacon picks five far-apart verifier nodes that ping each identity, and the vector of round-trip times splits like light through a prism into a seal set by geography. Heads returning matching vectors across many epochs share one reward share until they prove separate hosting. A farm on one box or region shows one seal for every key, a nebula of clones; hiding means renting compute in many regions, a cost that grows per head. Honest agents docked at one big cloud wharf may collide, so a merge is a soft cap with appeal, not a burn.
